item.title: 'Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain' Is Real, And It's Coming To Switch 2

description.p: Hello, old friend.Level-5 is really bringing out the throwbacks these days, huh? After years of waiting, the studio today unveiled a first look at Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain, confirming that it'll be coming to Switch 2.We still know very little about this one at the time of writing, but the brief teaser trailer showed us a brief look at protagonist Nate and a couple of his Yo-kai pals. It's a remake of Yo-kai Watch 2: Bony Spirits & Fleshy Souls, which launched in Japan in 2014 before coming West two years later.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: New Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Trailer Showcases Some Wuhu Island Exploration

description.p: Return of the Matt.We don't have all that long to wait before Nintendo Switch Sports Resort launches on Switch 2 on 22nd October, and today, Nintendo has shared a few more details of what we can expect.Chief among the newly revealed features is free island exploration. As showcased in the new trailer, you'll be able to make your way around Wuhu Island by skateboard, jet ski, or plane, and there are even collectible hibiscus flowers and Spocco Photos to collect while you're at it.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Professor Layton And The New World Of Steam Finally Has A Release Date

description.p: It's been 84 years.After years of waiting and a fair few delays, Professor Layton and The New World of Steam finally has a Switch 1 & 2 release date: 10th December 2026.The first mainline game in over a decade, The New World of Steam sees Layton and Luke team up in the land of Steam Bison — a hop across the pond from the pair's previous escapades — to solve the mystery of a phantom gunslinger terrorising the town.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Hyrule Warriors: Age Of Calamity Is Getting Definitive Edition On Switch 2 Next February
